title: Atlas Towers, Precursor Tablets, and the Map Device
summary: How the 0.5.4 Atlas tower system works: find and clear a Tower, place Precursor Tablets from the Atlas screen, and run the target map in the Map Device. Includes a legacy-tutorial conflict check and a 'tablet not working' diagnostic.
description: A correction guide for Path of Exile 2 Atlas Towers and Precursor Tablets: the current discover-to-place flow, the distinction from the Map Device, and how to read remaining tablet uses.
imageAlt: Precursor Tablets used to modify maps around a Tower in the Path of Exile 2 Atlas
prerequisites: Campaign completed on at least one character
Access to the Atlas map screen and the Map Device
A discovered Tower node on your Atlas
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: How do I actually use a Precursor Tablet?
body: You cannot use a tablet straight from your inventory. You must find a Tower on the Atlas, clear it to activate its Precursor Beacon, and then place tablets into that Tower from the Atlas screen. Each Tower holds up to 3 tablets and they apply to every map inside its radius.

items.title: Why don't my maps show the tablet's effect?
body: Check three things: the target map must sit inside the Tower's radius, the tablet's remaining uses must not be exhausted, and the modifier must apply to that map. If all three are fine and the effect still does not appear, it may be a UI bug rather than a setup error.

items.title: Do tablets go into the Map Device?
body: No. The Map Device is where you slot a Waystone and actually run the map. Precursor Tablets are placed into the completed Tower from the Atlas screen, not into the Map Device.

sections.title: Legacy tutorials vs the current version
sections.intro: Several older tutorials describe a tablet flow that no longer matches 0.5.4. Treat the following as outdated.

conflicts.recommendation: Do not right-click a tablet onto a Tower node
conflicts.detail: Older guides show right-clicking a tablet directly onto a tower node on the Atlas. In 0.5.4 you place tablets from the Atlas screen after clearing the tower, not by clicking the tablet in your inventory.

conflicts.recommendation: There is no 'walk into the radius aura' step
conflicts.detail: Legacy explanations describe a radius aura you physically walk into to receive effects. Tablets now apply from the Tower on the Atlas screen to all maps in its radius; you never enter an aura.

sections.title: The current tower and tablet flow
paragraphs: The 0.5.4 flow has four stages. First, you discover or find a Tower node on your Atlas. Second, you enter and clear the Tower map. Third, clearing the Tower activates a Precursor Beacon. Fourth, you place Precursor Tablets into that Tower from the Atlas screen.

A placed tablet modifies every map inside the Tower's radius. This is a regional system: one tablet can upgrade an entire cluster of maps at once, and tablets stack when multiple Towers overlap the same maps.
bullets: You cannot use a tablet from your inventory on a tower directly.
Tablets are placed from the Atlas screen, never from the Map Device or inventory.
Each Tower holds up to 3 Precursor Tablets.

sections.title: How to find and reach a Tower
paragraphs: Towers appear as special map nodes on the Atlas. Early on, Doryani's quest line points you toward your first Precursor Tower, which in turn unlocks the central city region.
bullets: Open the Atlas screen and look for the Tower node icon among your reachable maps.
Towers revealed by fog typically sit on the edges of explored regions.
Prioritise a Tower whose radius already covers the maps you plan to run.
Clearing a Tower also grants Atlas passive points and a guaranteed tablet drop, so it is worth routing toward early.

sections.title: Clearing the Tower
paragraphs: Enter the Tower map from the Atlas and defeat its content. Completing the Tower is what makes it usable for tablets.
bullets: Use a Waystone of an appropriate tier for your character's power.
Once cleared, the Tower node becomes a completed Tower on your Atlas.
Completed Towers drop an extra Precursor Tablet as a clear reward.

sections.title: The Precursor Beacon activates
paragraphs: After you clear the Tower, a Precursor Beacon activates. The beacon is what lets you open the Tower's tablet slots from the Atlas screen.
bullets: You will see the Tower become interactable on the Atlas once the beacon is active.
Only completed Towers (beacon active) can hold tablets.
If the Tower shows no slots, re-check that the clear registered and the beacon is active.

sections.title: Where Precursor Tablets come from
paragraphs: Precursor Tablets drop from monsters while you map. Mechanic-specific tablets have a higher drop chance from their own content: Breach tablets from Breach monsters, Expedition tablets from Expedition, and Overseer tablets from map bosses.
bullets: Generic Precursor Tablets also drop from normal map monsters, though less often.
Each completed Tower grants a guaranteed tablet drop.
Tablets drop as normal, magic, or rare; rare tablets carry more modifiers.
You can push tablet drops by adding the relevant modifier to your Waystones.

sections.title: Running the target map in the Map Device

steps.label: Place the tablet in the Tower (Atlas screen)
body: Open the Atlas, select the completed Tower, and slot your Precursor Tablet(s) into its slots from the Atlas screen.

steps.label: Open the Map Device
body: The Map Device is a separate interface where you run the actual map; it is not where tablets go.

steps.label: Insert a Waystone for the target map
body: Choose a map that sits inside the Tower's radius and insert its Waystone into the Map Device.

steps.label: Run the map
body: Launch the map. The tablet's modifiers apply because the map is inside the Tower's radius. Each run consumes one use of the tablet.

sections.title: Why is the tablet's mechanic not showing?
sections.intro: Pick the symptom. The tool points to the most likely cause.

options.label: Effect vanished after a few runs
Cannot place the tablet at all

rules.title: The map is outside the Tower's radius
steps: Open the Atlas and confirm the target map sits inside the Tower's radius ring.
Move your farming to a map clearly within the radius.
Remember the modifier must also apply to that map type.

rules.title: The tablet's uses are exhausted
steps: View the remaining uses on the tablet in the Tower's slots.
A tablet is consumed per map run it applies to; replace it with a fresh tablet.
Do not assume an unlimited effect; check the remaining-uses counter.

rules.title: The Tower is not completed or beacon inactive
steps: Confirm the Tower is cleared and the Precursor Beacon is active.
You cannot place tablets into an uncleared Tower or from your inventory.
Complete the Tower map first, then place from the Atlas screen.

defaultResult.title: Still nothing? Check for a UI bug
steps: Re-open the Atlas screen and re-confirm the radius and remaining uses.
If the setup is correct but the effect is missing, it may be a UI bug; re-log and re-check.
Avoid blaming a single cause; verify radius, uses, and map type together.

sections.title: How tablet modifiers stack
paragraphs: A Precursor Tablet's modifiers apply to all maps in the Tower's radius and combine with Waystone modifiers and Atlas passive bonuses.
bullets: Tablet effects stack with Waystone affixes on the same map.
Atlas passive nodes that boost tablet effect multiply the benefit.
Overlapping two or three Towers over the same maps stacks their modifiers.
Do not treat a tablet as a replacement for a Waystone; they are complementary.

steps.label: Confirm the radius
body: Make sure the target map is inside the Tower's radius on the Atlas screen.

steps.label: Confirm remaining uses
body: Check the tablet shows remaining uses before you launch the run.

steps.label: Confirm the target map
body: Insert the correct Waystone into the Map Device for a map inside the radius.

sections.title: Use the tablet now or save it?
sections.intro: A high-value tablet is tempting to hoard. Weigh the trade-off.

rows.risk: You spend a limited tablet run
rows.reward: Immediate juiced maps and a steady tablet return from farming
rows.when: You are actively farming maps inside the radius

rows.risk: Missed farming efficiency now; tablets may sit unused
rows.reward: Keep a strong tablet for a planned push
rows.when: You are between farming sessions or lack a fitting radius

rows.risk: Tablets pile up and expire in value as you out-level content
rows.when: Avoid this; use tablets to keep supply flowing

sections.title: Common player questions
sections.intro: Real questions players ask about the tower and tablet system.

cards.title: I can't put the tablet in the tower
body: You cannot place a tablet from your inventory. Clear the Tower first so the Precursor Beacon activates, then slot tablets from the Atlas screen.

cards.title: My tablet is not working
body: Most often the map is outside the radius, the uses are exhausted, or the Tower is not completed. Check all three before assuming a bug.

sections.title: Troubleshooting the tower and tablet UI
paragraphs: Most tablet problems come from following an outdated tutorial, a misclick, or a genuine UI bug. Do not assume a single cause.
bullets: Outdated tutorial: you followed a right-click or aura guide - use the Atlas-screen flow instead.
Misclick: you tried to place the tablet from inventory - clear the Tower and use the Atlas screen.
Bug: setup is correct but the effect is missing - re-open the Atlas and re-check, or re-log.
Always verify radius, remaining uses, and map type together before blaming one factor.

items.question: Can I use a Precursor Tablet directly from my inventory?
answer: No. You must clear the Tower to activate its Precursor Beacon, then place tablets into the Tower from the Atlas screen. Inventory placement does not work in 0.5.4.

items.question: How many tablets does a Tower hold?
answer: A completed Tower holds up to 3 Precursor Tablets. The exact slot behaviour is described against the live 0.5.4 Atlas and should be confirmed in-game.

items.question: What happens to a tablet's uses?
answer: A tablet is consumed per map run it applies to. View the remaining uses on the tablet in the Tower's slots; once it reaches zero the tablet is spent.

items.question: Can an Orb of Augmentation or Regal Orb upgrade a tablet?
answer: An Orb of Augmentation can add a modifier to a Magic tablet. A Regal Orb cannot upgrade a tablet to Rare through normal use; tablet rarity behaviour should be verified against the current patch.

items.question: Do tablet modifiers stack with Waystones and Atlas passives?
answer: Yes. Tablet modifiers apply to all maps in the Tower's radius and combine with Waystone affixes and Atlas passive bonuses, and stack across overlapping Towers.
